en.t: After nightfall, I went to the small inn.

units.source_text: 舞女正在向她的阿妈学习三弦琴。

en.t: The dancing girl was learning the shamisen from her mother.

units.source_text: 她一眼瞧见我，就停下手了。

en.t: As soon as she caught sight of me, she stopped playing.

units.source_text: 阿妈说了她几句，她才又抱起三弦琴。

en.t: Only after her mother said a few words to her did she pick up the shamisen again.

units.source_text: 歌声稍为昂扬，阿妈就说：

en.t: Whenever her singing rose a little, her mother would say:
